title: How Firm a Foundation
lyrics_original: Than to you He has said,
On the land, on the sea,
And will still give you aid;
Help you, and cause you to stand,
Waters I call you to go,
For I will be with you,
The flame shall not hurt you;
I will not, I will not

bible_verses.english: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.”
However God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”
that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my safe refuge and firm foundation. When life feels uncertain or overwhelming, help me to anchor my heart in Your holy Word. Teach me to trust Your faithfulness in every circumstance, whether in abundance or in need. I rest my life in Your capable hands today, knowing Your promises will never fail me. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When the seasons of life shift beneath our feet, God’s Word stands as an unshakeable anchor for our souls. Jesus invites all who are weary to run to Him, finding safety and rest in the truth of His enduring promises. Whether you are walking through times of quiet joy or facing deep uncertainty, your life is securely anchored in His unchanging love. Let this song remind you today to rest completely on the solid rock of Christ.
